cohort: The study participants were 55,477 adult women aged >=20 years old, recruited using a multistage, stratified, cluster sampling method from six geographic regions of mainland China.
finding: The prevalence of symptomatic POP in adult Chinese women was 9.6%, with symptomatic POP-Q stage II, mainly involving anterior compartment prolapse, being the most common type.
mod_finding: Multiple vaginal deliveries (>=3 vs nulliparous) increased the odds of symptomatic POP-Q stage II or higher (OR increased from 1.91 to 2.78).
